gauge.name: Big Sandy Creek (Trinity River Basin) near Bridgeport

impacts.statement: Major flooding is expected along the creek. Farm and ranch land near the creek will be flooded, along with rural roads.
Moderate flooding is expected along the creek. Farm and ranch lands near the creek will be flooded, along with some rural roads.
Minor overbank flooding is expected along the creek. Some rural roads and farm and ranch land near the creek will begin to flood.

hydronotes.statement: River forecasts for this location take into account past precipitation and the precipitation amounts expected approximately 24 hours into the future from the forecast issuance time.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are issued as needed during times of high water, but are not routinely available.
